csv_scope_of_work: This Request for Proposal (RFP) will result in a multi-year 5-year base Firm-Fixed Price multiple award Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts to provide Aviation Engineering Support Services for US Forest Service owned aircraft. This contract requires professional aerospace, mechanical, and metallurgical engineering services and related work in compliance with the terms, specifications, and provisions of this contract. This includes furnishing labor, equipment, supervision, transportation, ordering supplies, and incidentals.
